title: Intent to Sole Source - 10th Mountain Ski Club - Fort Kent Outdoor Center - Biathlon Range and Facilities
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU
detail_text: The Vermont Army National Guard (VTARNG) has a requirement for an International Biathlon Union (IBU) Class B biathlon range and associated facilities (including timing building, warming facility, etc.) to host the National Guard Biathlon Eastern Invitational race (NGBEI) 25-30 MAR 2026. Technical requirements: • IBU Class B facility • Snow grooming capability • Range with 30 firing points • Timing Building • Warming facility• Located below 6,500 feet/ 1850 meters altitude • Within 50 miles of military billets • Within a 2 hour travel distance from a major airport • Located within the Continental United States (CONUS) • Capacity to host an event for approximately 150 participants and associated personnel • Availability to host that event 25-30 MAR 2026 Interested parties that believe that they have the capability to satisfy all of the above requirements are invited to submit responses challenging the intent to award to 10th Mountain Ski Club on a sole source basis not later than 13 MAR 02026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time. To be considered responsive, submissions must squarely address all technical requirements identified above.
